fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6TBD; there was no owner. The planner read internal/session/names.go and its callers in internal/api (session.go, run.go, run_leaves.go, run_checks.go, ship.go, ship_openpr.go), where each one re-derives the branch and worktree from session.Slug(title). It asked one question, how to make slugs unique. The arbiter answered with Decision slug-unique-by-earliest-id: a change set whose title slug matches an earlier change set's (lower ID, any state) gets a short-ID suffix, and one function over the model gives the slug to every caller. The planner settled the PR guard itself: ship tracks only a pull request whose body names this change set, using the 'Change set <id>' line that open-pr already writes, and refuses any other. The change set serves m29-one-daemon, as the sibling governor fixes do.
fields.title: Unique change set slugs, autonomous plan
